title: Northgate Cash Delivery-Program Bonus for Northgate+ Members
content:
**Bonus rule.** Under the consumer earning schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the delivery program of the order adds percentage points to the earning percentage of the line the schedule settles:

- a line on a **Northgate Same-Day Delivery** or **Northgate Drive Up** order of a membership on a paid Northgate+ tier adds **1** percentage point;
- a line on a **Northgate Ship to Home** or **Northgate Order Pickup** order of a membership on a paid Northgate+ tier adds **0.5** percentage points;
- any other line adds no points.

The fulfilment program is the program the order is held in on its Northgate Store and Online Orders record. A paid Northgate+ tier, for this schedule, is Northgate+ Assist, Northgate+ Student, Northgate+ Monthly or Northgate+ Annual; a Northgate Rewards membership adds no points whatever the program.

**Points by program and tier**

| Fulfilment program of the order | Paid Northgate+ tier | Northgate Rewards |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery | 1 | 0 |
| Northgate Drive Up | 1 | 0 |
| Northgate Ship to Home | 0.5 | 0 |
| Northgate Order Pickup | 0.5 | 0 |
| Northgate In-Store Purchase | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | 0 | 0 |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Northgate+ Monthly member's selected line sits on a Drive Up order: the line's earning percentage carries 1 added percentage point. The same line on an In-Store Purchase order would carry none from this bonus.
